mapper.insert: insert into weaning_records (house_id, batch_id, breeding_cycle_id, rabbit_id, target_cage_id, in_cage_id, weaning_date, weaning_count, waiting_count, male_count, female_count, avg_weight, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{batchId}, #{breedingCycleId}, #{rabbitId}, #{targetCageId}, #{inCageId}, #{weaningDate}, #{weaningCount}, #{waitingCount}, #{maleCount}, #{femaleCount}, #{avgWeight}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select w.id, w.house_id, w.batch_id, w.breeding_cycle_id, w.rabbit_id, w.target_cage_id, ct.cage_number as target_cage_number, w.in_cage_id, ci.cage_number as in_cage_number, group_concat(concat(coalesce(ca.cage_number, concat('#',a.cage_id)), '×', a.alloc_count) order by a.cage_id separator ',') as alloc_summary, w.weaning_date, w.weaning_count, w.waiting_count, w.male_count, w.female_count, bc.male_rabbit_id as sire_rabbit_id, w.avg_weight, w.remark, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time from weaning_records w inner join batches b on b.id = w.batch_id left join breeding_cycles bc on bc.id = w.breeding_cycle_id and bc.house_id = w.house_id left join cages ct on ct.id = w.target_cage_id and ct.house_id = b.house_id left join cages ci on ci.id = w.in_cage_id and ci.house_id = b.house_id left join weaning_record_allocations a on a.weaning_record_id = w.id left join cages ca on ca.id = a.cage_id and ca.house_id = b.house_id where w.house_id = #{houseId} and b.house_id = #{houseId} and w.batch_id = #{batchId} group by w.id order by w.id desc limit #{limit}

select w.id, w.house_id, w.batch_id, w.breeding_cycle_id, w.rabbit_id, w.target_cage_id, ct.cage_number as target_cage_number, w.in_cage_id, ci.cage_number as in_cage_number, group_concat(concat(coalesce(ca.cage_number, concat('#',a.cage_id)), '×', a.alloc_count) order by a.cage_id separator ',') as alloc_summary, w.weaning_date, w.weaning_count, w.waiting_count, w.male_count, w.female_count, case when w.male_count is null or w.female_count is null or w.male_count + w.female_count <> w.weaning_count then null when count(a.id) = 0 and w.waiting_count = w.weaning_count then w.male_count when count(a.id) = count(a.male_count) and count(a.id) = count(a.female_count) and coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) + coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) = coalesce(sum(a.alloc_count), 0) and w.male_count >= coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) and w.female_count >= coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) and w.male_count + w.female_count - coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) - coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) = w.waiting_count then w.male_count - coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) else null end as waiting_male_count, case when w.male_count is null or w.female_count is null or w.male_count + w.female_count <> w.weaning_count then null when count(a.id) = 0 and w.waiting_count = w.weaning_count then w.female_count when count(a.id) = count(a.male_count) and count(a.id) = count(a.female_count) and coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) + coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) = coalesce(sum(a.alloc_count), 0) and w.male_count >= coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) and w.female_count >= coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) and w.male_count + w.female_count - coalesce(sum(a.male_count), 0) - coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) = w.waiting_count then w.female_count - coalesce(sum(a.female_count), 0) else null end as waiting_female_count, bc.male_rabbit_id as sire_rabbit_id, w.avg_weight, w.remark, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time from weaning_records w inner join batches b on b.id = w.batch_id left join breeding_cycles bc on bc.id = w.breeding_cycle_id and bc.house_id = w.house_id left join cages ct on ct.id = w.target_cage_id and ct.house_id = b.house_id left join cages ci on ci.id = w.in_cage_id and ci.house_id = b.house_id left join weaning_record_allocations a on a.weaning_record_id = w.id left join cages ca on ca.id = a.cage_id and ca.house_id = b.house_id where w.house_id = #{houseId} and b.house_id = #{houseId} and w.batch_id = #{batchId} and b.status = '进行中' and w.waiting_count > 0 group by w.id order by w.id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) as recordCount, coalesce(sum(waiting_count), 0) as waitingCount from weaning_records where house_id = #{houseId} and batch_id = #{batchId} and waiting_count > 0

select id, house_id, batch_id, breeding_cycle_id, rabbit_id, target_cage_id, in_cage_id, weaning_date, weaning_count, waiting_count, male_count, female_count, avg_weight, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from weaning_records where house_id = #{houseId} and batch_id = #{batchId} and id = #{id}

select id, house_id, batch_id, breeding_cycle_id, rabbit_id, target_cage_id, in_cage_id, weaning_date, weaning_count, waiting_count, male_count, female_count, avg_weight, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from weaning_records where house_id = #{houseId} and batch_id = #{batchId} and id = #{id} for update

select w.id, w.house_id, w.batch_id, w.breeding_cycle_id, w.rabbit_id, w.target_cage_id, ct.cage_number as target_cage_number, w.in_cage_id, ci.cage_number as in_cage_number, group_concat(concat(coalesce(ca.cage_number, concat('#',a.cage_id)), '×', a.alloc_count) order by a.cage_id separator ',') as alloc_summary, w.weaning_date, w.weaning_count, w.waiting_count, w.male_count, w.female_count, bc.male_rabbit_id as sire_rabbit_id, w.avg_weight, w.remark, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time from weaning_records w inner join rabbits r on r.id = w.rabbit_id left join breeding_cycles bc on bc.id = w.breeding_cycle_id and bc.house_id = w.house_id left join cages ct on ct.id = w.target_cage_id and ct.house_id = r.house_id left join cages ci on ci.id = w.in_cage_id and ci.house_id = r.house_id left join weaning_record_allocations a on a.weaning_record_id = w.id left join cages ca on ca.id = a.cage_id and ca.house_id = r.house_id where w.house_id = #{houseId} and r.house_id = #{houseId} and w.rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} group by w.id order by w.id desc limit #{limit}
